subject: general
question: Plaster of Paris is not used for ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**for cooking.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• **Uses of plaster of paris:**
 
• A **building substance **called plaster of Paris is applied as a **protective** **finish **to **walls **and **ceilings**.
 
• For **decorative elements**, it is also employed as a **moulding **and **casting agent**.
 
• It is **utilised **to provide the buildings **decorative finishing touches**.
 
• Plaster is used in **orthopaedics **in the **medical field **to encase **broken bones **in casts. This cast will help the **bone** **recover **and return to its previous state.
 
• **Historical constructions **and **monuments **are made with it.
 
• In the **fresco painting**, it is also **utilised**. Because it won't shrink even when submerged in water, it is utilised to create replicas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• The **colour **of plaster of Paris is **white powder**.
 
• It's constructed out of **gypsum**.
 
• **Gypsum**, the main component of the plaster, is abundantly available in Paris; hence, the name.
 
• The white powder is mixed with water to create a paste, which when **dry solidifies **into the **desired structures**.
 
• Therefore, plaster of paris is used to create **moulds **and **casts**.
